difficulty_reason: 以McMullen–Schulte的平坦混合定理为明确标准输入，本题仍须沿任意秩选择共同二维截面，证明FAP向下一层共面继承，才能反复构造指定全部三维截面的有限正则多胞形。作者在源224–263实际计算正规闭包的商与半直积，主证364–419据此闭合归纳并推出2^(n3+...+nd−3(d−3))群阶；这些相容性与遗传条件不能仅靠乘群阶代替。保留完整本地继承证明后，此结构构造支持H2；不将标准混合定理自身的证明贡献计为本题H3。

editorial_notes: All four original authors, including Egon Schulte, are credited; r001 is retained.
review_reason: The proof constructs a regular polytope with prescribed toroidal rank-three sections by an induction that must simultaneously preserve compatible sections, flatness and several flat-amalgamation properties. It proves the local hereditary FAP mechanism, identifies the relevant normal closures in the mixed automorphism group, and derives the exact power-of-two order recurrence; these structural obligations are retained rather than assumed.
